Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding utilization review of physical therapy services covered by industrial insurance.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to utilization review of physical therapy servicesfor persons receiving industrial insurance benefits; and adding a newsection to chapter 51.36 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 51.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If the department contracts with a utilization review vendor forphysical therapy services and the vendor's recommendation is notreceived within fortyeight hours of the request, the department shallpay the physical therapy provider for any visits by the injured workerthat occur while the vendor's recommendation is pending.
